# Infinitum Corporation

Infinitum Corporation is an international security and technology consulting firm founded by William Aaron Turner. Its work sits at the intersection of information technology, cybersecurity and modern defense and security concepts.

- Website: https://www.theinfinitumcorporation.com
- X: https://x.com/infinitumceo

## Ukrainian Files

*Ukrainian Files* is a research blog by William Aaron Turner, President of Infinitum Corporation. It lays out the sources, figures and named claims behind *The Ukraine Files* series of X Articles: aid and NGOs, sanctions and the Russian economy, the Eastern Economic Forum, In-Q-Tel, mobilization and intelligence.

- Blog: https://ukrainianfiles.blogspot.com/
- Full series (reading order): https://ukrainianfiles.blogspot.com/p/the-ukraine-files-full-series.html
- About the author: https://ukrainianfiles.blogspot.com/p/about.html
- Follow on X: https://x.com/infinitumceo

# X Articles by William Aaron Turner

Long-form X Articles by **William Aaron Turner** ([@infinitumceo](https://x.com/infinitumceo), ORCID [0009-0002-1585-5442](https://orcid.org/0009-0002-1585-5442)), President of [Infinitum Corporation](https://www.theinfinitumcorporation.com), Washington, DC. Part of [The Ukraine Files](https://ukrainianfiles.blogspot.com/p/the-ukraine-files-full-series.html).

1. **[Meat Grinder to the Medical Freezer: A One Stop Shop For a Ukrainian Soldier](https://x.com/i/article/2083666042295906307)** (2026-08-02)  
   William Aaron Turner examines organ-harvesting allegations tied to Ukraine's war dead, name by name, using open sources. A Ukraine Files X Article.

2. **[Grandmas, Toddlers, and Forklift Drivers](https://x.com/i/article/2089708406206586880)** (2026-08-18)  
   How Ukraine's list of "military targets" keeps widening to civilians: grandmothers, children and workers. An X Article by William Aaron Turner.

3. **[The Kidnapping of a Nation: Ukraine's Forced Mobilization, Human Trafficking, & Organ Harvesting](https://x.com/i/article/2090751273901457408)** (2026-08-21)  
   Vans, detention and a state at war with its own men: William Aaron Turner documents Ukraine's forced mobilization and trafficking claims.

4. **[Zelenskyy: The West's lil' Frankenstein Monster – the Anatomy of a Geopolitical Puppet](https://x.com/i/article/2091939536875958273)** (2026-08-24)  
   Who built Zelenskyy's rise, part by part: backers, media networks and Western money. A Ukraine Files X Article by William Aaron Turner.

5. **[WTF is IN-Q-TEL: CIA Investment Arm That Has Its Hand in Everything](https://x.com/i/article/2091940977485156352)** (2026-08-24)  
   In-Q-Tel, the CIA's venture capital arm, and the pipeline from Silicon Valley to Ukraine's battlefields. An X Article by William Aaron Turner.

6. **[The Art of Not Giving a F*ck: How Russia Is Laughing All the Way to Victory While the West Panics](https://x.com/i/article/2095859080581554178)** (2026-09-04)  
   Sanctions, aid and GDP: why 50 countries' pressure has not broken Russia's economy. A Ukraine Files X Article by William Aaron Turner.

7. **[Checkmate in Vladivostok: EEF (Eastern Economic Forum)](https://x.com/i/article/2096677873231044608)** (2026-09-08)  
   The Eastern Economic Forum 2026 in Vladivostok: delegations from dozens of countries and the deals that challenge Russia's isolation story.

8. **[SWEEPS AND SPIES](https://x.com/i/article/2096961143344635905)** (2026-09-08)  
   Russia clears the bombs; the West clears the data. William Aaron Turner on demining NGOs and intelligence links from Laos to Moldova.
